<documents>
<document id="savings-interest-calc">
HowˆsavingsˆinterestˆisˆcalculatedˆInterestˆonˆSavingsˆPocketsˆisˆcalculatedˆeveryˆdayˆandˆpaidˆonceˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆHowˆit'sˆcalculatedˆEachˆdayˆweˆworkˆoutˆinterestˆonˆtheˆbalanceˆinˆeachˆpocketˆatˆyourˆplan'sˆrate,ˆandˆitˆcompoundsˆdaily.ˆTheˆAPYˆalreadyˆincludesˆtheˆeffectˆofˆcompounding.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆpaidˆInterestˆforˆtheˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆeachˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth,ˆandˆshowsˆasˆ"Interest".ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆYourˆplan'sˆAPYˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆthatˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ##ˆChangingˆplansˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplans,ˆtheˆnewˆrateˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆInterestˆforˆearlierˆdaysˆinˆtheˆmonthˆusesˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆRateˆchangesˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆWeˆgiveˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆnoticeˆbyˆemailˆbeforeˆweˆlowerˆaˆrate.ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="support-what-we-can-do">
WhatˆourˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆsortˆoutˆmostˆthingsˆduringˆyourˆchat.ˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆandˆaˆfewˆthingsˆweˆcan'tˆdoˆatˆall.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcanˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆReportˆaˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆandˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆ-ˆOpenˆaˆdisputeˆthat'sˆinsideˆitsˆwindow,ˆhasˆposted,ˆandˆtotalsˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆRefundˆaˆfeeˆunderˆourˆrefundˆpolicyˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆplanˆ-ˆCloseˆyourˆaccountˆifˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆzeroˆandˆnothingˆisˆpendingˆorˆdisputedˆ-ˆExplainˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆpoliciesˆ##ˆSupportˆpassesˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteamˆ-ˆ**Fraud:**ˆsuspectedˆaccountˆtakeover,ˆremovingˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆscamˆpaymentsˆ-ˆ**Disputes:**ˆdisputesˆaboveˆtheˆsupportˆlimitˆ-ˆ**Verification:**ˆidentityˆchecks,ˆlegalˆnameˆorˆdate-of-birthˆchanges,ˆaccountsˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆ-ˆ**AccountˆServices:**ˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆaˆdeceasedˆaccountˆholder,ˆfinancialˆabuseˆ-ˆ**Complaints:**ˆformalˆcomplaintsˆSpecialistˆteamsˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcan'tˆ-ˆActˆfor,ˆorˆshareˆdetailsˆwith,ˆanyoneˆotherˆthanˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆ-ˆGiveˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadviceˆ-ˆRaiseˆlimitsˆ-ˆRefundˆfeesˆoutsideˆtheˆrefundˆpolicy,ˆorˆopenˆdisputesˆafterˆtheirˆwindowˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
